title: Leny Yoro injury leaves Manchester United with one senior centre-back for Chelsea trip
content:
Leny Yoro is set to miss Manchester United’s trip to Chelsea leaving Michael Carrick’s side with just one senior central defender for Saturday night’s game.

The France Under-21 international, 20, has picked up an injury and has not travelled with the rest of the squad to London.

It remains to be seen how serious the setback is but multiple sources with knowledge of the situation, who asked to remain anonymous in order to protect relationships, indicate he won’t be available for the game at Stamford Bridge leaving Carrick with a selection headache.

As reported by The Athletic earlier this week both Harry Maguire and Lisandro Martinez will also miss out while serving suspensions after recent red cards.

Maguire was sent off in the draw with Bournemouth earlier this month before seeing his ban upgraded, while Martinez was dismissed for a hair-pull on Dominic Calvert-Lewin in Monday night’s defeat by Leeds United.

Matthijs de Ligt is a long-term absentee and hasn’t featured since November with a back injury.

Ayden Heaven, the 19-year-old defender signed from Arsenal in February of last year, is the only recognised senior centre-back now at Carrick’s disposal for what is a crucial game in the race for Champions League qualification.

United sit third in the Premier League ahead of Saturday’s meeting, seven points ahead of Liam Rosenior’s side with six games of the season remaining.
